invariants.rationale: The method is called on records, which are immediately accessed; null would cause a NullPointerException.
A non-positive outputPartitions likely wouldn't make sense for repartitioning records.
The parameter is explicitly typed as List<HoodieRecord<T>>.
List.size() is always non-negative in Java.
It's possible that assigning more partitions than records has no effect; otherwise, this is a plausible constraint.
